mpBlkReplace.Description: Quick replacement of blocks or entities in a drawing with a specified block
mpBlkReplace.FullDescription: Three modes are available: Replace selected - allows to replace all selected blocks by one specified block; Replace similar - allows to replace all instances of one block by one specified block; Replace entities - allows to replace selected entities of Circle, Ellipse and Point types by one specified block. It allows to delete the description of the replaced block from the drawing base. Similar to the command "PURGE". Various settings are available
mpBlkReplace.h3: Select multiple blocks to replace them
mpBlkReplace.h5: Remove replaced blocks from the drawing database?
mpBlkReplace.h10: Transformation (mirror and rotation) of replaced block
mpBlkReplace.h18: Attributes with the same name of replaced block
